name: Wall Sit
description: An isometric leg exercise: with your back flat against a wall, slide down until your thighs are about level with the floor and hold.

source.title: Wall Sits (Cleveland Clinic)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand with your back against a wall and walk your feet about two feet forward.
cues: Knees stay over your ankles, not past your toes.
Keep your whole back against the wall.
Go only as low as is comfortable; a higher sit is still useful.

prescription.note: Breathe steadily throughout; don't hold your breath.

keyframes.name: Back to the wall
keyframes.cue: Feet forward, back flat on the wall.

keyframes.name: Slide down and hold
keyframes.cue: Slide down until your thighs are about level, then hold.
